title: Per-frequency-bin predictive power spectrum
interpretation: Per-frequency-bin predictive power spectrum: 1101 bins, 1101 eval days, 13-day window.
M2 (lunar, 22.365 uHz): predictive power = +2.18%, RMS = 0.628 m.
S2 (solar, 23.148 uHz): predictive power = +2.37%, RMS = 0.624 m.
M2 vs S2 predictive power difference: -0.19%.
Solar tidal lines carry more predictive power than lunar. This could indicate an atmospheric contribution to the solar tidal prediction.
pre_registered_prediction: If TEP is real, the predictive power spectrum should show peaks at lunar tidal frequencies (M2, O1, N2) that are purely gravitational. The M2 (22.365 uHz) should carry more predictive power than the nearby S2 (23.148 uHz) which has an atmospheric counterpart. The lunar mean predictive power should exceed the solar mean.
